C1147.title: China’s Cyberspace Administration Bans Big Data Price Discrimination, Ending Algorithmic Bias for Kunming Users
keywords: Internet Information Service Algorithmic Recommendation Provisions
C1147.summary: In January 2022, four government bodies including the Cyberspace Administration of China issued the Internet Information Service Algorithmic Recommendation Management Provisions, prohibiting unreasonable practices such as algorithmic discrimination and big data-enabled price gouging.
